import Part
doc=App.getDocument("hook_lesson5"); sh=doc.Body.Shape
def xs(z,y=-15):
    # solid extent along X at height z, midwidth y=-15 (away from holes unless z=15/45)
    l=Part.makeLine(App.Vector(-1,y,z),App.Vector(56,y,z)).common(sh)
    return sorted((round(e.BoundBox.XMin,3),round(e.BoundBox.XMax,3)) for e in l.Edges)
print("z=7.5 (lip):",xs(7.5,-10)); print("z=30:",xs(30,-10)); print("z=2.5:",xs(2.5,-10))
print("z=7.5 near edge y=-1:",xs(7.5,-1))
l=Part.makeLine(App.Vector(1,-10,-1),App.Vector(1,-10,61)).common(sh); print("plate z extent",l.BoundBox.ZMin,l.BoundBox.ZMax)
print("width y",sh.BoundBox.YMin,sh.BoundBox.YMax)
for f in sh.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder" and abs(f.Surface.Axis.x)>0.9:
        print("hole d",2*f.Surface.Radius,"y",f.Surface.Center.y,"z",f.Surface.Center.z, "through", round(f.BoundBox.XLength,3))
s=doc.Spreadsheet; print({a:s.get(a) for a in ("hook_depth","thickness","lip_height","plate_height","width","hole_d","hole_spacing")})
print(doc.Pad.ExpressionEngine,doc.Hole.ExpressionEngine)
